text:
Ava Chen: Quick check — pulled the weekly dashboard slice for webinar funnel. Landing page sessions up 22% after the paid push but conversion to registrants dropped ~18%. Anyone else seeing a jump in bounce on /webinar/signup?
Jamal Ortiz: I saw that too. looks like paid traffic is higher but CTR on the CTA is lower. Could be mismatch in variants. :thinking_face:
Priya Nair: Did we change the UTM mapping for the paid creative? I remember QAing a tag last night.
Elena Kuznetsova: Not from content side — creative is same. I can re-export the ad UTM list.
analytics-bot: Automated snapshot: GA4 sessions: 12,432 (+22%), Registrations: 1,045 (-18%), SFDC leads created: 980 (-20%).
Ava Chen: SFDC vs GA4 discrepancy still ~6% gap, which is expected but the drop pattern looks correlated to campaign start time (2026-03-18 10:00 UTC).
Jamal Ortiz: Can someone run the quick query on source/medium vs landing_page? I want to see if a routed redirect is stripping utm_campaign. Small SQL: ```SELECT source_medium, landing_page, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM events WHERE event_date between '2026-03-11' and '2026-03-18' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20;```
Priya Nair: running now — will paste results in a sec.
analytics-bot: Query started by Priya Nair (Clickhouse) — ETA ~12s.
Priya Nair: result paste: top rows show paid/google_cpc -> /webinar/signup (sessions 3,600) and paid/google_cpc -> /webinar?utm_missing (sessions 820). Looks like some clicks hit the tracking redirect.
Elena Kuznetsova: ah ok that explains lower registrants — redirect page doesn't render the modal correctly on mobile. I can push a fix to the redirect by EOD.
Ava Chen: Nice catch. For reporting: do we want to keep paid in the dashboard as a single channel or split by redirect vs direct hits? For weekly KPI deck I prefer single channel but add a footnote about redirect leakage.
Jamal Ortiz: Agreed — aggregate for execs, but add a slide with the split and remediation plan.
Priya Nair: I'll update the Looker dashboard: add a filterable dimension for redirect_tag_present (true/false) and annotate the last two weeks as influenced by redirect bug.
Elena Kuznetsova: I'll also coordinate with ads to pause the affected creative for next 24 hours until fix is live. @ads-team FYI.
Ava Chen: Plan: Elena to fix redirect, Priya updates dashboard and adds note, Jamal will draft the slide for Monday all-hands with the split and impact, I'll monitor registrants once fix is live.
Jamal Ortiz: Slide draft logged in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (private) — will share in #all-hands channel tomorrow. :thumbsup:
analytics-bot: Tagging done: impact_estimate=~15% of paid conversions, remediation_eta=2026-03-20 18:00 UTC.
Ava Chen: Thanks team — small thread but huge impact. Reopen if numbers don't normalize after fix. :rocket:
